title: Apply to sit a land or mining surveyor exam
summary: Learn how to apply to sit the Board of Surveying and Spatial Information (BOSSI) exams to become a registered land or mining surveyor.
intro:
Candidate land or mining surveyors need to sit Board of Surveying and Spatial Information (BOSSI) exams to become registered surveyors.

To sit the exam you have to apply and be accepted. If your application is not accepted, BOSSI will refund your application fee.
who_can_apply: Paid your annual candidate surveyor enrolment fee
Completed the specified minimum period of recognised practical work experience
Check BOSSI guidelines and determinations for specific eligibility and exam requirements
what_you_need: Your supervising surveyor’s full name, contact details and registration number
A creditor debit card to pay the application fee

how_to_steps.text: Select the 'Start' button on the application screen.
Follow the prompts to proceed to payment.

faqs.q: What is required to become a registered surveyor?
faqs.a: Candidate land or mining surveyors must sit BOSSI exams to become registered surveyors.

faqs.q: What happens if my application to sit the exam is not accepted?
faqs.a: BOSSI will refund your application fee.

faqs.q: Where can I find specific eligibility and exam requirements?
faqs.a: Visit the BOSSI guidelines and determinations.
